## About
The River Poker Club is a poker room in Spring, close to home for a lot of players in the north Houston area. One reviewer called it a nice little spot close to their house, and that is the kind of place we are.
Players describe a quiet, friendly atmosphere with a security guard on duty in the evenings. We are rated 4.3 on Google from 47 reviews.

## Services
- Cash games: Sit down at a cash game table and play.

## FAQ
Q: Is there security on site?
A: Yes. A reviewer mentioned a security guard on duty in the evenings.

Q: Are snacks provided?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we have the best free snacks of all the poker rooms in the Houston area.

## What customers say
- "Just moved here from St. Louis. Was looking for poker room since there are no casinos in town and gave this place a shot after checking out some of the local spots. Did not disappoint. Nice, clean environment, big tables, nice chairs, and plenty of huge flat screens to have the games on.
The owner, Jerry, is very friendly and the dealers the night I was there were on point, professional, and friendly. Jerry keeps pretty good snacks, candy, and drinks well stocked for the players and a huge fridge for your liquor of choice (can't beat BYOB!) should you decide to partake. Have only been here for cash games but hope to check out a tournament soon." (Zac Pyles, 5/5)
- "Great environment to play poker.
Quiet friendly atmosphere and security guard on duty in the evenings.
New owner Jeff has put a lot of money into the place and he's not done yet." (Global4life, 5/5)
- "I am pleased with the new ownership and management.  Dealership controlling the table from abusive and talking and showing cards....." (Professor Carlos, 5/5)
- "Nice little spot close to my house. They have the best free snacks of all the poker rooms in the Houston area!" (Connie Holmes, 5/5)
